To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) a tree-based hierarchical DCNs are not optimal, (ii) a flat DCN architecture with server-centric topology is more efficient than a hierarchical DCN architecture with switch-centric topology, (iii) congestion notification algorithms are essential for a DCN architecture, (iv) TCP Incast is a serious problem for modern DCN, and (v) energy-efficient solutions can be applied to reduce the power consumption in modern DCN architectures.
the most promising solutions for the DCN architecture are the fat-tree, the Clos, the VL2 and the PortLand.
